description:
Tell us a rule is wrong: the fee went up, a beach closed to dogs, a hotel now takes two pets.
For a record the traveler says is wrong or out of date; this is the one tool that writes. The report goes to a person who re-reads the official source, and the record does not change until it is verified: a report is filed, not a fix.
Inputs: place_id from a result, message (what is wrong, in the traveler's words), optional fact (which kind of fact is wrong), optional source_url of the official page, optional contact if the traveler offers one. No other personal detail is accepted.
The answer carries a ticket id and a status_url. The ticket's status (filed, then verified or rejected) is public there; what they wrote is not.

contact.description: How to reach the reporter, only if they offer it

fact.description: What kind of rule is wrong, if clear. Shown on the public ticket; the message is not.

message.description: What is wrong, in the user's words

place_id.description: Place id from a search result

source_url.description: The official page that shows the current rule, if the user has it

name: dogpolicies_report_correction

accepted.description: With bad_input: each argument that could not be read, with the values it accepts

code.description: With an outcome other than ok: not_found, invalid, unavailable

did_you_mean.description: Close matches to what was asked for: towns, places, slugs or brands, best first

nearest.description: When nothing is inside the radius: the nearest places in the data, with distance_miles

next.description: Calls that would answer the question, in words

outcome.description: Absent or ok: a normal answer. no_match: nothing in the data matches, see did_you_mean, nearest and next. bad_input: the arguments cannot be used as given, see next. partial: some of the ids were found, see missing. unavailable: a live source could not be read. None of these is an error.

resolved_from.description: Set when a word was read as the value the tool uses: hotel as lodging, NB as north. Each key is the argument; asked is what was sent, used what it was read as

status.description: filed, or not_sent with form_url to file it by hand

status_url.description: Where the ticket's status (filed, verified, rejected) is public

ticket.description: Public ticket id (c-xxxxxxxx) once filed; null otherwise

title: Report a correction
